svg.title: Remote Agent fleet management
svg.desc: The same provisioning command runs on three remote hosts; each registers as an agent and installs ThingsBoard Edge from the shared application profile. When Edge 4.4 is released, the application profile is upgraded once and a single bulk upgrade runs on every host. Two hosts finish on Edge 4.4; one fails and rolls back with its data restored, without affecting the others.

g.text: 1 · One provisioning command, the same on every host
2 · Each host registers itself and installs Edge automatically
3 · A new Edge version: upgrade the application profile once
4 · One bulk upgrade for the whole fleet
5 · Every host upgrades, and rolls back, on its own
